result.brief: 提出条件化响应状态世界模型，用临床与治疗条件调制潜状态转移，并因子化分离响应动态与影像外观，用于纵向DCE-MRI疗效预测。
result.reason: Latent state-transition world model with conditioned dynamics and factorized response-state representation, but applied to medical longitudinal MRI outcome prediction rather than video/multimodal foundation world models.
